copy.headline: From pre-K to school funding, Texas Dems hope power shift gives education priorities momentum
copy.caption: Education bills filed ahead of next year’s session include those that failed in a GOP-controlled Legislature. Democrats now have the House, but the Senate retained a Republican majority.
